Warm LCP difference is clearer in this cohort: En Reve minus Web Awesome mobile52ms CI[36,68], desktop8ms CI[8,12]. This is not source-level causality and richer date/other native capabilities remain confounders.
Scripted INP differs by one8ms quantization step: mobile8ms CI[0,8], desktop8ms CI[-4,8]. Avoid claiming a robust universal responsiveness winner.
